prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Image1 is the exact1x2 native launch-plate geometry target. Image2 is the SELECTED workshop material/style reference only; do not draw its building, roof, grilles, doors or windows.

Create ONE isolated EMPTY launch plate with ONE low horizontal folded service arm, ready state, NE view. Crisp chunky M1 transport-game hardware: concrete-gray metal deck, charcoal perimeter frame, pale cream small mechanism housing and restrained ochre safety accents, upper-left light.

Match Image1's equal-scale2:1 isometric footprint: ONE cell down-left, TWO cells down-right. Ground contacts at1024-square source size: NORTH(448,350), EAST(704,478), SOUTH(576,542), WEST(320,414). Plate thickness16px above these contacts; no separate apron or surrounding floor. Both world axes have exact2:1 slope. Keep the complete plate's physical base edges clearly visible.

The first/upper-left cell is an unobstructed launch area with one simple unlabelled pale circular landing outline, approximately centred at(448,414). Put ONE short jointed service arm folded HORIZONTALLY at the far/right end, approximately(640,478), entirely inside the second cell. A small cream motor housing and charcoal folded beam form ONE mechanism, not a vehicle. Arm height no more than48px above the plate. No tall mast, vertical tower, crane boom or equipment outside the plate.

ONE complete cutout in the centre of a SQUARE1024x1024 canvas, with at least100px of real transparent margin on every side. No guide colours, contact dots, labels, text, numbers, logos, frame, magenta, cast shadow outside the plate, cargo, crates, rocket, probe, pod, people, vehicle, tanks, road, track, water, scenery, second plate, extra machinery or extra views. Preserve true alpha. The whole empty plate and its single folded arm must fit safely within the one-by-two native area.
